title: P0 Store slice 回归保护测试 (skillsSlice + conversationSlice)
description: 为 P0 关键 store slices 补全 companion pattern 回归保护测试：skillsSlice 缺少任何测试文件，conversationSlice 同样缺少测试。需覆盖状态转换、loading 状态、错误处理、边界条件等核心回归场景。
action: Create skillsSlice.test.ts, skillsSlice.additional.test.ts, conversationSlice.test.ts, conversationSlice.additional.test.ts under desktop/src/stores/app/ using Zustand createHarness() pattern from projectSlice.additional.test.ts

criteria: cd desktop && npx vitest run src/stores/app/skillsSlice.test.ts --reporter=verbose exits 0
cd desktop && npx vitest run src/stores/app/conversationSlice.test.ts --reporter=verbose exits 0
convergence.verification: Run vitest for each new test file in desktop/ and confirm all pass with 0 failures
convergence.definition_of_done: skillsSlice 和 conversationSlice 均有基础测试和 additional companion 测试，覆盖状态转换、错误处理、边界条件，所有测试通过

files.change: Create基础describe block覆盖toggleSkill添加/移除、默认availableSkills、selectedSkills初始为空、refreshAvailableSkills成功路径
Create companion test覆盖refreshAvailableSkills失败路径（!response.success、空skills、空nextSkills、catch吞错）、toggleSkill边界（空字符串、重复toggle）、selectedSkills过滤逻辑

Create companion test覆盖selectConversation对不存在ID的no-op、updateConversationTitle边界（不存在conversation、title未变）、addMessage在null currentConversationId时自动创建、deleteMessage/editMessage在无当前对话时的early return、workspace seed创建和resolve逻辑

implementation: Read skillsSlice.ts to understand toggleSkill (add/remove filter) and refreshAvailableSkills (listSkills API call, guard clauses for !response.success, empty skills, empty nextSkills, try/catch silent swallow)

Create skillsSlice.test.ts: import createSkillsSlice + type SkillsSlice, define type SetFn, create createHarness() with stub defaults, test: toggleSkill adds skill to selectedSkills, toggleSkill removes existing skill, default availableSkills equals DEFAULT_AVAILABLE_SKILLS, selectedSkills starts empty, refreshAvailableSkills with mocked listSkills success populates availableSkills and filters selectedSkills

Create skillsSlice.additional.test.ts: describe('skillsSlice additional coverage'), test refreshAvailableSkills with listSkills returning {success: false} (keeps fallback), listSkills returning empty skills array (keeps fallback), listSkills returning skills with non-string id or whitespace-only id (filters out), listSkills throwing (catch swallows, keeps fallback), toggleSkill with empty string, double toggle (add then remove)

Read conversationSlice.ts + shared.ts to understand createConversation (Date.now ID, workspace seed), addMessage (auto-create when null currentConversationId), selectConversation (no-op on missing), updateConversationTitle (no-op on missing/unchanged), deleteMessage/editMessage (early return when no current conversation)

Create conversationSlice.test.ts: import createConversationSlice + shared helpers, create harness with mock set/get, test: createConversation creates entry in conversationsById, adds ID to allConversationIds, sets currentConversationId; selectConversation switches active; addMessage adds message to current conversation; deleteMessage removes by messageId; editMessage updates content and timestamp; getConversationById returns correct conversation

Create conversationSlice.additional.test.ts: describe('conversationSlice additional coverage'), test: selectConversation with non-existent ID (no state change); updateConversationTitle with missing conversationId (no-op); updateConversationTitle with same title (no-op); addMessage when currentConversationId is null (auto-creates then adds); deleteMessage with no currentConversationId (early return, no crash); editMessage with no currentConversationId (early return); workspace seed from createConversationWorkspaceSeed

commands: cd desktop && npx vitest run src/stores/app/skillsSlice.test.ts src/stores/app/skillsSlice.additional.test.ts --reporter=verbose
cd desktop && npx vitest run src/stores/app/conversationSlice.test.ts src/stores/app/conversationSlice.additional.test.ts --reporter=verbose

reference.pattern: Zustand slice companion test pattern (createHarness with SetFn type alias, patchState helper)

rationale.chosen_approach: Follow existing companion test pattern (projectSlice.additional.test.ts) exactly — createHarness with mutable set/get, patchState helper — to maintain consistency and avoid test structure rewrites per Locked constraint #1
decision_factors: skillsSlice has zero test coverage — P0 regression risk
conversationSlice has zero test coverage — P0 regression risk
Both are pure synchronous + async slices following same Zustand AppSlice pattern
Shared helpers (shared.ts) already have partial test coverage
rationale.tradeoffs: Creating 4 test files per slice pair (base + additional) increases file count but follows established convention and makes coverage gaps visible

risks: refreshAvailableSkills depends on listSkills from @/api/client — need vi.mock('@/api/client') for async tests
conversationSlice depends on shared.ts helpers (createConversationRecord, createConversationWorkspaceSeed, etc.) — may need to mock or import directly
Date.now().toString() in createConversation produces non-deterministic IDs — tests should verify structure, not exact ID values
